archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) infused with soft lavender
emotional_tone: Calm, grounded, luxurious, mindful, and elegant.

rules.headings: Never center by default; use left-alignment for organic reading flow. Use font-light or font-medium for an editorial, elegant look rather than heavy bolds.
rules.body: Keep line lengths comfortable (max-w-prose). Ensure body text is easily readable against the cream background.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The Bento Grid Protocol - Mode A (Tetris). Emphasize asymmetry. Overlap images over text containers slightly to break rigid box structures.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for soft, inviting edges. Avoid harsh sharp corners.

surface_treatment.cards: Solid flat backgrounds (#ffffff or #f2ecfa) with delicate 1px border (#9480d6 at 15% opacity). No heavy drop shadows; use subtle, diffuse ambient shadow if necessary: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(148,128,214,0.05)].
surface_treatment.hero_overlay: Do NOT use heavy black/white blankets. Let the image breathe. If text must overlay the image, use a delicate gradient or backdrop-blur with low opacity.

components.navigation: Sticky header using 'Optical Clarity' glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#faf6ed]/80). Include a clear 'Book Now' CTA button.
components.buttons: Primary CTAs: bg-[#9480d6] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#7c68bf] transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#9480d6] text-[#9480d6] rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#9480d6]/5.
components.forms: Minimalist Shadcn inputs. Use border-b only (flair/elegant) or softly rounded inputs with very subtle borders. No heavy box shadows.
components.payment_section: Razorpay integration on 'Book Now' flow. Checkout card should be clean, distraction-free, using a white background over the cream body to elevate the transaction area. Clearly display class details, price, and secure payment badges.
components.cards_and_listings: For Classes and Blog: Avoid standard rigid grids. Alternate image left/right layouts or use staggered masonry-style layouts.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: -translate-y-1 transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-out. Images should have a slow, subtle scale effect on hover (scale 105 over 0.8s).
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Use staggered fade-up animations (Framer Motion) for text blocks and images. Keep it slow and deliberate to match the mindful, zen aesthetic.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Consider adding Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling to make the site feel premium.

hero_background.description: Modern yoga studio with large windows and natural light. Perfect for an asymmetrical hero layout.

about_section.description: Woman practicing yoga gracefully in a modern, airy studio. Use for the philosophy or instructor highlight.

classes_listing_1.description: Diverse group practicing yoga. Use for Vinyasa or group class descriptions.

classes_listing_2.description: Two women embracing a yoga pose. Great for partner yoga or specialized workshops.

media.style_rules: Images must have rounded corners matching the layout (rounded-2xl). Avoid slapping generic gradients over them.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) must include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-book-now-button', data-testid='contact-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure HTML/Tailwind is used for primary marketing layouts to maintain asymmetry and fluidity. Avoid rigidly wrapping everything in Shadcn 'Card' components.
Implement a sticky navigation with a blurred cream background.
Integrate Razorpay correctly for the 'Book Now' flow inside the Classes section.
Use Cormorant Garamond for headings and Manrope for body text. Do not use Inter.
Use the specific colors requested: #9480d6 for accents/buttons and #faf6ed for the main background.
